title: Add a Copilot Studio agent to Power Apps
subtitle: Use the supported path: publish the agent, enable Microsoft 365 Copilot, switch it on in the app, then publish.

steps.title: Publish the agent to channels
steps.evidence: publish the agent to Teams and Microsoft 365

steps.title: Enable it for the environment
steps.evidence: open Copilot, then Microsoft 365 Copilot, and set canvas apps to On for the chosen environment

steps.title: Switch on M365 Copilot in the app
steps.evidence: set M365 Copilot in the app on make.preview.powerapps.com before publishing

steps.title: Publish the canvas app
steps.evidence: switch it on in the app, then publish
